Title: Sign in with valid credentials
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in)
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app 2. Tap Sign In 3. Select "Sign in to an existing account" 4. Select "Sign in with Amazon" 5. Enter a valid email address 6. Enter the valid password 7. Tap Sign In
Expected result: The user is signed in and the account name is shown
Actual result: User can sign in with valid credentials

Title: Sign in with invalid credentials
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app 2. Tap Sign In 3. Select "Sign in to an existing account" 4. Select "Sign in with Amazon" 5. Enter an invalid email address 6. Enter an invalid password 7. Tap Sign In
Expected result: Error "There was a problem. We cannot find an account with that email address" is shown
Actual result: User cannot sign in; error "There was a problem. We cannot find an account with that email address" is shown

Title: Sign in with valid email and invalid password
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in)
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app 2. Tap Sign In 3. Select "Sign in to an existing account" 4. Select "Sign in with Amazon" 5. Enter a valid email address 6. Enter an invalid password 7. Tap Sign In
Expected result: Error "There was a problem. Your password is incorrect" is shown
Actual result: User cannot sign in; error "There was a problem. Your password is incorrect" is shown

Title: Upload a JPEG profile picture
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in; a JPEG image is available on the device
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app and sign in with a valid account 2. Open your profile 3. Select Edit profile 4. Select Upload image 5. Select the JPEG file and upload it
Expected result: The profile picture is uploaded and shown in the profile
Actual result: The JPEG file was uploaded and the profile picture is shown in the profile

Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app and sign in with a valid account 2. Open your profile 3. Select Edit profile 4. Select Upload image 5. Select the PNG file and upload it
Expected result: The profile picture is uploaded and shown in the profile

Title: Upload a PDF as profile picture (unsupported format)
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in; a PDF file is available on the device
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app and sign in with a valid account 2. Open your profile 3. Select Edit profile 4. Select Upload image 5. Select the PDF file and try to upload it
Expected result: The PDF is rejected; only JPG or PNG up to 25 MB are accepted
Actual result: The PDF could not be uploaded; only JPG or PNG with a maximum size of 25 MB can be uploaded

Title: Create a private people list
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in
Steps: 1. Open the profile menu 2. Select Your Lists 3. Select Create a new list 4. Select the People list type 5. Enter a list name 6. Set the visibility to Private 7. Save the list
Expected result: The list is available under Your Lists and is visible only to its creator
Actual result: The list is available under Your Lists and is visible only to its creator

Title: Create a public people list
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in
Steps: 1. Open the profile menu 2. Select Your Lists 3. Select Create a new list 4. Select the People list type 5. Enter a list name 6. Set the visibility to Public 7. Save the list
Expected result: The list is available under Your Lists and is visible to other users as well
Actual result: The list is available under Your Lists and is visible to other users as well

Title: Create a people list with many entries
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in
Steps: 1. Open the profile menu 2. Select Your Lists 3. Select Create a new list 4. Select the People list type 5. Enter a list name 6. Add 20 names to the list 7. Save the list
Expected result: The list with all added names is available under Your Lists
Actual result: The list was created and is available under Your Lists

Title: Add a person to an existing list
Precondition: IMDb Android app (version 8.9.1) installed; network connection; valid IMDb account (Amazon sign-in); signed in; an existing People list
Steps: 1. Open the IMDb app and search for an actress 2. Open the actress profile page 3. Select Add to list 4. Select an existing People list
Expected result: The person is added to the existing list
Actual result: The person was added to the existing list
